scripts.build:ext: test -f extension/manifest.json || { echo 'SKIP build:ext (extension/manifest.json missing)'; exit 0; }; for m in background content main-world popup; do if [ "$m" = main-world ] && [ ! -f extension/src/content/main-world.ts ]; then continue; fi; vite build -c extension/vite.config.ts --mode "$m" || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ext.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
